Urban Concierge Brief: SF Bay Area

Thursday Oct 29 – Saturday Oct 31, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Thu Oct 29, 2026, 2:00 pm PT (BayAreaDailySync)

What changed since the last brief (Thu 6:08 am): rain is back for Halloween. NWS now gives a 40% chance of showers Saturday after 11 am and 50% Saturday night (under a tenth of an inch), so bring a layer for Castro, the Zoo and trick-or-treating. This morning's BART delay has cleared. New Caltrans notice: nightly SR-37 Petaluma River Bridge lane closures the week of Nov 2. Restaurant picks rotated.

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF, forecast updated 1:36 pm Thu): This afternoon mostly cloudy, high near 68, falling to around 65; tonight mostly cloudy, low around 55. Friday sunny, high near 65, southwest wind up to 12 mph; Friday night mostly cloudy, low around 54. Saturday (Halloween): mostly cloudy, high near 63, 40% chance of showers after 11 am; Saturday night 50% chance of showers, low around 53. Rainfall under a tenth of an inch.
Source: https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194&unit=0&lg=english&FcstType=text&TextType=1

Coastal Flood Advisory (reissued 4:23 am Oct 29; until Sat Oct 31, 6 pm PDT): up to 1.9 ft of inundation in low-lying areas along San Pablo Bay, SF Bay and Monterey Bay, worst along the Marin bayshore. Still in effect (re-checked 2 pm). Remaining SF high tides: 7.4 ft at 2:39 pm Fri, 6.9 ft at 3:44 pm Sat. Expect flooding of low-lying roads and isolated road closures.
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194

Road closures (Caltrans District 4)

  • SR-82 (El Camino Real), Burlingame, Carmelita Ave to Floribunda Ave: northbound lanes fully closed through Fri Oct 30, 9 am–6 pm, for tree removal. Detour via California Drive; SamTrans buses detoured. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-27-sr82-short-term-closure-ecr-tree-work
  • SR-84, La Honda to Woodside (Foxhill Rd to Memory Ln): one-way traffic control through Fri Oct 30, 7 am–5 pm, for striping. Weather dependent. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-27-sr84-traffic-control-striping-work
  • SR-29 (Sonoma Blvd), Vallejo: two lanes closed (one open) through Nov 6, Mon–Thu 9 am–6 pm, Fri 9 am–7 pm. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr29-daytime-two-lane-closure
  • SR-92/US-101, San Mateo: nightly ramp closures through Fri Oct 30 (Thu night the WB 92 to SB 101 loop ramp closes 9 pm–5 am). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr92-us101-nightly-ramp-closures
  • SF street closure: 18th St between Noe and Diamond closed Sat Oct 31, 11 am – 1 am Sun for Castro Halloween (cross streets stay open). https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/castro-halloween-saturday-october-31-2026
  • Looking ahead: SB US-101 Hospital Curve in SF closes Fri Nov 6, 11 pm – Mon Nov 9, 6 am (use SB I-280) https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-27-hospital-curve-closure · New: WB I-80 Bay Bridge down to one lane and the YBI on-ramp fully closed Thu Nov 12, 11:30 pm – Fri Nov 13, 4 am, to hang the holiday wreath https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-28-ybi-ramp-closure · SR-1 Devil's Slide tunnels close Thu Nov 5, 8 pm – Fri Nov 6, 4 am (carried) · New: SR-37 Petaluma River Bridge (Marin–Sonoma line) loses one lane each direction nightly 7 pm – 6 am, Nov 2–7 (westbound from noon Mon Nov 2) https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-29-sr37-petaluma-river-bridge
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org.

What's on (each confirmed on an official, venue or league page)

1) Exploratorium After Dark, "Creepatorium": Thu Oct 29, 6–10 pm. Pier 15, SF. Annual Halloween party with Gothicumbia and a science-themed costume contest. Tickets listed as in stock; price not shown on the event page.
https://www.exploratorium.edu/visit/calendar/after-dark-creepatorium

2) Sharks vs. Vancouver Canucks: Thu Oct 29, 7 pm. SAP Center, San Jose. Ticket prices not checked.
https://www.nhl.com/sharks/schedule

3) SF Opera, Massenet's Manon: Fri Oct 30, 7:30 pm. War Memorial Opera House, 301 Van Ness. Tickets "starting at $30". Last performance Sun Nov 1.
https://www.sfopera.com/operas/manon/

4) Warriors vs. Los Angeles Lakers: Fri Oct 30, 7 pm. Chase Center, Mission Bay. Ticket prices not checked.
https://www.nba.com/warriors/schedule

5) Boo at the Zoo (outdoors; showers possible after 11 am): Sat Oct 31, 10 am–3 pm. SF Zoo, Sloat Blvd at the Great Highway. Costume parade at 11 am, contest at noon, animal pumpkin smashing, trick-or-treat booth, DJ. Free with paid zoo admission; no full-face masks.
https://www.sfzoo.org/event/boo-at-the-zoo/

6) SFMOMAween: Sat Oct 31, 11 am–4 pm. SFMOMA, Floors 1, 2 and 4. Costume contest hosted by drag king Luismi Monstruo Rude at 1:30 pm (sign-up from 12:30), SCRAP art making 11 am–1 pm, shadow-puppet Lysistrata at 11 am and 2:30 pm. Free with museum admission.
https://www.sfmoma.org/event/sfmomaween/

7) Halloween Hoopla (outdoor garden; showers possible): Sat Oct 31, noon–3 pm. Children's Garden, Yerba Buena Gardens (799 Howard St). For kids under 10: Circus Bella, pumpkin patch, crafts and a costume parade. Free with RSVP.
https://ybgfestival.org/event/halloween-hoopla-2026/

Also listed: Sharks vs. Ottawa, Sat Oct 31, 1 pm, SAP Center (NHL schedule). Castro Halloween along 18th St from 11 am Sat (SFMTA page above). Crawloween pub crawl Fri 6–11 pm and Sat 2–10 pm, from $12 (organizer page) https://crawloween.com/tickets/

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Michelin's site blocked scripted loads this run, so Michelin descriptions are carried from earlier briefs where they were confirmed. Rotated picks.

Kin Khao, Union Square, SF (55 Cyril Magnin St) · Thai/Californian · $$$. Michelin praises its layered, produce-driven Thai cooking and warns some dishes are very spicy. Its own site (checked today): lunch daily 11:30 am–2 pm; dinner Sun–Thu 5:30–9 pm, Fri–Sat 5:30–10 pm. (415) 362-7456. Easy walk before Friday's Manon. https://www.kinkhao.com/

State Bird Provisions, Fillmore, SF (1529 Fillmore St) · Californian · Michelin One Star. Dim sum-style carts of seasonal California small plates; the menu changes often and reservations can be hard to get. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/state-bird-provisions

Anchor Oyster Bar, Castro, SF (579 Castro St) · seafood. Michelin calls it a tiny, old-fashioned counter spot with lines out the door, known for crab cakes, chowder, raw oysters and cioppino. Right by Saturday's Castro Halloween, so expect crowds. Hours unconfirmed. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/anchor-oyster-bar

Kokkari Estiatorio, Jackson Square, SF (200 Jackson St) · Greek (carried). A Greek favorite pairing San Francisco chic with old-world taverna hospitality. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/kokkari-estiatorio

Getting around

Muni and cable cars (carried): $2.85 single ride with Clipper, MuniMobile or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 minutes. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports 1-day $15, 3-day $35, 7-day $47. Youth 18 and under ride Muni free. https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares
Muni reroutes: Sat Oct 31 from 11 am, the 33 Ashbury/18th St reroutes around the Castro event, and the 24 and 35 may run late (confirmed this run). Other Halloween closures (Cortland, River of Life, Further Send Off), the Golden Gate Half Marathon Sun Nov 1 and Día de los Muertos Mon Nov 2 are carried. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates

BART:

  • This morning's 20-minute systemwide delay has cleared; the only live advisory at 2 pm is the one below.
  • Sun–Thu from 9 pm, expect 30-minute delays between Millbrae, SFO and Daly City for train control work (reposted 8:11 am Oct 29). Leave extra time for Thursday-night flights.
  • Through Fri Oct 30: late-night single tracking on the Yellow Line in Contra Costa County (carried).
  • Coming up: reduced BART-to-OAK service the night of Nov 4, and a 24th St–Daly City bus bridge Nov 14–15 (carried).
    Sources: https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories · https://www.bart.gov/guide/airport

Bikes and scooters (from the Oct 23 brief): Lyft Bike is $1 to unlock plus $0.19/min classic or $0.49/min ebike, or a $15 day pass. Lime and Spin hold SF permits. No sidewalk riding. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels

SFO cars and rides (from the Oct 23 brief): Rental Car Center via AirTrain Blue Line (24 hours). Lyft and Uber pick up on Level 5 of the Domestic Garage. Taxis at the Arrivals center islands. https://www.flysfo.com/passengers/ground-transportation

Where to stay

Per SF Travel, Union Square has most major hotels and the best transit links, and is a short walk to SFMOMA and Yerba Buena Gardens for Saturday; Hayes Valley and Civic Center put you by the opera and Zuni; Mission Bay is closest to Chase Center for Friday's Warriors game; Union Square also puts you a block from Kin Khao. https://www.sftravel.com/neighborhoods

Other items carried from earlier briefs, where they were confirmed. Nobody was contacted and nothing was signed up for.

  • Times are Pacific. Prices only where a cited page lists them.

  2. Ticket prices for the Sharks, Warriors and Creepatorium; SF Zoo and SFMOMA admission prices.
  3. Exploratorium, SFMOMA and Crawloween pages refused scripted loads this run (all confirmed in earlier briefs). Whether outdoor Halloween events change plans for rain is not posted.

Monday Oct 26 – Wednesday Oct 28, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Sun Oct 25, 2026, 10:01 pm PT (BayAreaDailySync)

What changed since the last brief (Sun 2:10 pm): the window now runs Mon–Wed. BART posted new nightly 30-minute delays from 9 pm between Millbrae, SFO and Daly City (Sun–Thu). I-80 into SF and SR-37 reopen early Monday. New events: Slow Pulp at the Fillmore (Tue and Wed), Andrew Huberman at the Masonic and Mo Welch at Punch Line (Wed). New restaurant picks: State Bird Provisions and Zuni Café. NWS reissued the Coastal Flood Advisory at 8:36 pm with the same terms.

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF, fetched 10:01 pm): Tonight partly cloudy, low around 55. Monday sunny, high near 65, west wind gusting to 22 mph. Monday night mostly clear, low around 52. Tuesday mostly sunny, high near 63, gusts to 21 mph. Tuesday night low around 52. Wednesday mostly sunny, high near 64; Wednesday night mostly cloudy, low around 54.
Source: https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194&unit=0&lg=english&FcstType=text&TextType=1

Coastal Flood Advisory (reissued 8:36 pm Oct 25; until Thu Oct 29, 3 pm PDT): up to 1.9 ft of inundation possible in low-lying areas along San Pablo Bay, SF Bay and Monterey Bay. SF high tides: 7.4 ft at 11:39 am Mon, 7.6 ft at 12:15 pm Tue, 7.7 ft at 12:56 pm Wed, 7.5 ft at 1:43 pm Thu (up to 90 minutes earlier or later around the Bay). Expect flooding of low-lying roads and paths, isolated road closures, and waves farther up the beach.
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194

Road closures (Caltrans District 4)

  • WB I-80 Bayshore Freeway (5th–15th St, SF) reopens Mon Oct 26, 6 am, and SR-37 Mare Island–Sears Point reopens Mon Oct 26, 5 am. Allow extra time on the first Monday commute. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-21-sr37-closure-update
  • SR-29 (Sonoma Blvd), Vallejo, Sequoia Ave to the Solano/Napa line: two lanes closed (one open), Oct 26 – Nov 6, Mon–Thu 9 am–6 pm, Fri 9 am–7 pm. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr29-daytime-two-lane-closure
  • SR-92/US-101, San Mateo: nightly ramp closures through Fri Oct 30. Mon–Thu the WB 92 to SB 101 loop ramp closes 9 pm–5 am. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr92-us101-nightly-ramp-closures
  • Also posted: SR-37 Petaluma River Bridge lane reductions this week, and nightly US-101 lane and ramp closures in Marin. Looking ahead: SR-1 Devil's Slide tunnels fully closed Thu Nov 5, 8 pm – Fri Nov 6, 4 am (detour via Sharp Park Rd, I-280 and SR-92). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org.

What's on (each confirmed on an official, venue or ticketing page)

Monday is quiet: none of the venues checked list a show Mon Oct 26.

1) Noe Valley Night Market: Tue Oct 27, 4:30–8:30 pm. Noe Valley Town Square and 24th St (Vicksburg–Sanchez). Halloween-themed: 40+ food, drink and artist booths, face painting, live music. Free. 24th St closes 2–10 pm; the 48 Muni is rerouted 1:30–10 pm.
https://noemerchants.com/nightmarket-vendors/ · https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/noe-valley-night-market-tuesday-october-27-2026

2) SF Opera, Massenet's Manon: Tue Oct 27, 7:30 pm. War Memorial Opera House, 301 Van Ness. Tickets "starting at $30"; 3 hr 25 min with two intermissions; French with English supertitles. Remaining dates Oct 30 and Nov 1.
https://www.sfopera.com/operas/manon/

3) Sharks vs. Buffalo Sabres: Tue Oct 27, 7:30 pm. SAP Center, San Jose. Ticket prices not checked.
https://www.nhl.com/sharks/schedule

4) Slow Pulp: Tue Oct 27 and Wed Oct 28, 8 pm. The Fillmore, 1805 Geary Blvd. Prices not listed on the venue feed.
https://www.thefillmore.com/shows · https://www.ticketmaster.com/slow-pulp-san-francisco-california-10-27-2026/event/1C0064A49383A7BE

5) Protocols with Andrew Huberman: Wed Oct 28, 7 pm. The Masonic (Nob Hill). Prices not checked.
https://www.sfmasonic.com/shows · https://www.ticketmaster.com/protocols-with-andrew-huberman-san-francisco-california-10-28-2026/event/1C006507D03F9240

6) Mo Welch (comedy): Wed Oct 28, 8 pm. Punch Line Comedy Club, SF. Prices not checked.
https://www.punchlinecomedyclub.com/shows

Also listed: Cobb's Comedy Club has Tokyo Kanpai Boys (in Japanese) Tue 7:30 pm and Poly Díaz (en español) Wed 7:30 pm. https://www.cobbscomedy.com/shows
Coming Thu Oct 29: Exploratorium After Dark "Creepatorium" Halloween party, 6–10 pm. https://www.exploratorium.edu/visit/calendar
No Warriors home games in this window; next is Fri Oct 30 vs. Lakers. https://www.nba.com/warriors/schedule

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Descriptions and hours are Michelin's unless noted; price signs are Michelin's.

State Bird Provisions, Fillmore, SF (1529 Fillmore St) · Californian · $$$ · Michelin One Star. Dim sum-style carts of seasonal California small plates, like dumplings, savory pancakes and liver mousse; the menu changes often. Reservations can be hard to get. Dinner daily 5:30–10 pm (10:30 Fri–Sat). Four blocks from the Fillmore for the Slow Pulp shows.
https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/state-bird-provisions

Zuni Café, Hayes Valley/Market St, SF (1658 Market St) · Californian/French · $$$. A San Francisco institution with a copper bar and wood-fired brick oven; Michelin says order oysters, the roast chicken for two and the gâteau Victoire. Closed Monday; Tue–Wed dinner 5–9:30 pm. Near the opera house for Manon.
https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/zuni-cafe

Kin Khao, Union Square, SF (55 Cyril Magnin St) · Thai/Californian · $$$. Michelin praises its layered, produce-driven Thai cooking and warns some dishes are very spicy. Its own site: lunch daily 11:30 am–2 pm, dinner Sun–Thu 5:30–9 pm (carried from the last brief). https://www.kinkhao.com/

Nopalito, NoPa, SF (306 Broderick St) · Mexican · $$. Blue-corn fish tacos, chilaquiles verdes, no reservations. Michelin lists 11:30 am–9 pm, except Wednesday 4:30–9 pm (carried). https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/nopalito

Burdell, Oakland (4640 Telegraph Ave) · $$$. Chef Geoff Davis's take on soul food. Closed Mon and Tue, so Wednesday only in this window (carried). https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/oakland/restaurant/burdell

Getting around

Muni and cable cars (carried from the last brief): $2.85 single ride with Clipper, MuniMobile or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 minutes. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports 1-day $15, 3-day $35, 7-day $47. Youth 18 and under ride Muni free. https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares
Muni reroutes: Tue Oct 27, the 48 skips 24th & Sanchez, Church and Dolores 1:30–10 pm for the Noe Valley Night Market. Coming up: Oct 31 Halloween closures and the Golden Gate Half Marathon Sun Nov 1. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates

BART:

  • New: Sun–Thu from 9 pm, expect 30-minute delays between Millbrae, SFO and Daly City for train control work. Leave extra time for late flights. (BART service advisory, posted 10 pm Oct 25.)
  • Tue Oct 27 – Fri Oct 30: late-night single tracking on the Yellow Line in Contra Costa County (carried).
  • Coming up: reduced BART-to-OAK service the night of Nov 4, and a bus bridge between 24th St Mission and Daly City Nov 14–15 (carried).
  • SFO: tap a contactless card or Clipper at the gate.
    Sources: https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories · https://www.bart.gov/guide/airport

Bikes and scooters (from the Oct 23 brief, not re-checked): Lyft Bike is $1 to unlock plus $0.19/min classic or $0.49/min ebike, or a $15 day pass. Lime and Spin hold SF permits. No sidewalk riding. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels

SFO cars and rides (from the Oct 23 brief): Rental Car Center via AirTrain Blue Line (24 hours). Lyft and Uber pick up on Level 5 of the Domestic Garage. Taxis at the Arrivals center islands. https://www.flysfo.com/passengers/ground-transportation

Where to stay

Per SF Travel, Union Square has most major hotels and the best transit links; Nob Hill is the upscale pick and close to the Masonic; Hayes Valley and Civic Center put you by the opera and Zuni. https://www.sftravel.com/neighborhoods

  3. BART's planned-work list beyond tonight's advisory feed (the advisories page didn't render); Yellow Line, OAK and bus-bridge items are carried.
